events.summary: Starting benchmark qualification and engine implementation. Checking fresh Codex execution, official datasets/scorers and isolation before claiming trial readiness.

Qualified a pinned real RepoQA release: 600 tasks, six languages, 60 repositories, verified source/license hashes and upstream gold/empty scorer checks. Sentinel advances a bounded non-LLM retrieval assay; fresh Codex trials remain held by an authentication failure.

Implemented scan/flat/graph engines and a real read-only stdio MCP with source evidence and revision checks. Five engine tests pass, including real SDK initialize/list/call round trips, six-language parsing, stale/forged evidence and budget/path bounds. Sentinel: transport works; no agent effectiveness claim.

Added a reusable MCP client and fresh-session Codex adapter with permitted-field and isolation guards. Readiness probe still fails before inference because CLI authentication cannot refresh. Sentinel: deterministic assay can proceed; Codex agent comparisons and confirmatory monetary accounting remain held.

Measured all 1,800 frozen task/arm outcomes on 600 real RepoQA cases; 480 tasks held out by repository. Graph 38.33%, flat 38.13%, lexical scan 46.04%. Sentinel retains the null/negative outcome and distinguishes this non-LLM corpus assay from agent repair performance.

Compiled and reviewed a branded 12-page results white paper. All measured outcomes and pre-query code hashes agree; 9 engine/adapter/analysis tests, 4 publisher tests and 6 methodology tests pass. Sentinel: graph advantage unsupported; preserve study and hold agent-repair claims behind authentication/isolation/accounting gates.
